UNSAFE_style.description:
**Use at your own risk:** Custom style for specific elements. This should only be used as a
**last resort**. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

current.description: The number of items that are currently completed

header.description: Component to render above the progress bar.

inProgress.description:
The number of items in progress (not completed, but to be less than the total);
not applicable with stepped variation

loading.description: If the progress bar is loading, the progress indicators aren't rendered on the screen

reverseTheme.description:
If the amountFormatted and totalAmountFormatted text needs to appear more visibile because of the
background, for example

size.description: Set the size of the progress bar

total.description: The total number of items to be completed

variation.description: Set the variation of the progress bar
